description: United States Congresswoman of the 29th District endorsed Christina Morales for Texas House District 145. The Congresswoman made her decision based on Morales's long history of community service leadership. I know what kind of leader the hard-working people of this District deserve. That is why I am endorsing my friend Democrat, Christina Morales, to continue the legacy of strong leadership in House District 145. -- U.S. Rep. Sylvia Garcia
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Christina Morales Campaign, Gracie Saenz, Treasurer
title: U.S. Rep. Garcia Endorses Morales
